stem:
The diagram shows a colour scale from $-100$ to $+100$ for the difference between per capita rice and wheat use. Region R is marked with value $+40$. Krish reads the infographic.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Region R has per capita rice and wheat use of 40 in total.
Region R prefers wheat more strongly than rice.
Region R shows a stronger rice preference than wheat by the encoded difference 40.
Any coloured region can be ranked by shade alone before reading the scale.

teacher.key_rationale: Positive values encode stronger rice preference on this difference scale, so +40 means rice over wheat by that encoded amount. 40 kg total invents a new quantity. Preferring wheat reverses the sign. Ranking by shade before the scale skips what the numbers mean.
teacher.figure_note: Added colour scale legend and region R marked +40.
